blurb: Blue & Gold Fleet offers ferry service and sightseeing cruises around San Francisco Bay, including the famous one-hour San Francisco Bay Cruise, the 90-minute Escape from the Rock Cruise around Alcatraz Island, and a Sunset Cruise. They operate a fleet of 26 vessels and provide multi-language audio tours accessible via Wi-Fi enabled devices. Ferry service is available to multiple destinations including Sausalito, Harbor Bay, Alameda, Oakland, Richmond, and more.
